title: A token expires mid-run
prompt: A nightly full run of the 38,400-page policy wiki returns 30,000 pages because the source token expired mid-crawl. The code still finalized the bulk upload. What happens?

options.text: Nothing, because Glean keeps every document it has already indexed.
options.feedback: Bulk indexing replaces the document list. Omitted documents are deleted unless the safeguard pauses them.

options.text: The 8,400 missing pages are deleted within minutes.
options.feedback: Above 20%, stale deletion pauses for 7 days. Immediate deletion requires /processalldocuments.

options.text: About 22% would be deleted, so deletion of those documents pauses for 7 days. The run is still wrong.
options.feedback: Right. 8,400 of 38,400 is about 22%, above the 20% threshold. The pause buys time; it does not fix the run. Never let a partial fetch finish as a successful full crawl.

takeaway: The safeguard buys time. It never makes a partial run correct.
